transcription.method: Direct visual reading using tools.view_image of annotation-cleaned full source pages at 144 dpi; no OCR.
transcription.observations: Read the two column headings, three full-width category headings and each of the 13 practice/utility pairs directly from page-72.png. Read source line beneath table; preserved each city list in order, including Malkapur and MWCI.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent visual comparison of pages 72 and 74-76 against candidate cells, after earlier draft and sibling-batch comparison; no OCR, not independent human review.
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every cell, group heading and source note. Confirmed the two cross-page logical rows and repeated merged objective labels.
